package.description: Package Files and Software in Installers for Easy Distribution

en-US.description: Package Files and Software in Installers for Easy Distribution
en-US.longDescription:
Paquet Builder is a powerful installer software and an advanced Self-Extracting 7z (7zip archive) tool designed for professional file and software distribution.
With Paquet Builder, you can easily create compact, fully-customized Windows installer packages that simplify software delivery and enhance user experience.
en-US.name: Paquet Builder

zh-CN.description: 将文件和软件打包成安装程序以便轻松分发
zh-CN.longDescription:
Paquet Builder 是一款功能强大的安装程序制作软件，同时也是专业的自解压 7z（7zip 压缩包）工具，专为高效的文件与软件分发而设计。
通过 Paquet Builder，您可以轻松创建精简、高度定制化的 Windows 安装包，从而简化软件交付流程并提升终端用户体验。
